text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. poll gives Bahrain high rating as a tourism destination in the Middle East.
- Investment in the food sector for the first six months of 1997 stood at 1.1 million dinars, almost equal to total 1996 investment of 1.3 million dinars, a government official says.
- Bahrain moves to maintain hotel safety standards by intensifying inspection to ensure high-quality services to all visitors, a government official says.
- Bahrain is winning its battle against video piracy, smashing what was once a $30 million a year industry, an official says.
- Electricity demand and energy consumption in Bahrain fell substantially last month. Maximum power demand recorded on June 17 was 1,044 megawatts against the installed capacity of 1,200 megawatts.
- Bahrain exhibition centre to host 23 exhibitions by the end of 1998.
- Bahrain's share index rose around 14 points on Tuesday to 1,837.35 points, the highest level so far this year. Around 5.5 million shares were traded on Tuesday.
